comment.body:
Thanks for the attached report. I inspected the available Settings entries and module event exports, but they do not identify the process or call path behind the title. Please do not re-upload the same ZIP.

1. Give short numbered steps: which module/window you open, the last action before the error, and whether it happens every time.
2. Copy the full visible error text, or upload a screenshot through the GitHub web UI with personal content hidden, and identify which window displays it.

This distinguishes an actual stack overflow in a specific module from another fatal-error message and lets us investigate the correct owner.

judgment.rationale: There is not enough evidence to choose a module or safe code change. Ask for the exact visible failure and triggering sequence rather than requesting the already supplied archive or guessing that every selected area has the same defect. Empty event exports are not proof no crash occurred.
